faq.q: What does the Steveston page cover — just the village?
faq.a: No — the live feed carries all three board sub-areas, Steveston North, Steveston South and Steveston Village, so the page covers the whole Steveston district of south-west Richmond, from the village core and Garry Point to the residential streets north of Steveston Highway.

faq.q: Is Steveston a City of Richmond neighbourhood name?
faq.a: Steveston is the district name; the board listing names are Steveston North, Steveston South and Steveston Village, while the City plans the area under the Steveston Area Plan, Schedule 2.4 of the Official Community Plan, and designates the core as the Steveston Village Heritage Conservation Area.

Confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file: Lord Byng Elementary (3711 Georgia St), Westwind Elementary (11371 Kingfisher Dr) and Diefenbaker Elementary (4511 Hermitage Dr), with R.A. McMath Secondary (4251 Garry St) and Hugh Boyd Secondary (9200 No. 1 Rd) serving the district's sides; catchments are address-based, so confirm the exact address in the SD38 locator (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

Yes — it fronts the South Arm of the Fraser River in the Richmond floodplain, behind the City perimeter dike system with drainage pump stations; Bylaw 8204 sets dike setbacks and flood construction levels, the City is raising dikes from 3.5 m to 4.7 m, and the Steveston Island Dike project addresses this waterfront specifically.
